title: Viva Engage: community feeds default to all posts, sorted by recent posts
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's planned feed defaults, sticky preferences and November rollout window. Its licensing and administrator-control gaps are appropriately qualified. One checklist sentence should retain Microsoft's qualification that completion by the end of November is expected, not guaranteed.
